justification: Panel A depicts a winged anthropomorphic figure holding objects, rendered in a naturalistic relief style with anatomical detail (wings, muscles, drapery); panel B shows an abstract geometric composition (a spiral rosette bordered by dots, flanked by small schematic animals, framed by wave-pattern bands) with no human or winged figure at all. There is no shared subject matter: no common creature type, no comparable pose, and no equivalent combination or arrangement of motifs between the two works.
